name: delegcheck
one_liner: Offline static linter for agent-delegation configuration files (MCP-style descriptors, agent manifests, tool registries).
problem: Agent harnesses increasingly delegate authority across principals (orchestrator -> worker, worker -> sub-agent, agent -> MCP tool). When the delegation configuration itself is shape-defective - bearer credentials without scope or expiry, tools without a principal identity, authorization gated inside the model, parent credentials reused verbatim, delegation edges without a depth cap, wildcard callers, cross-principal edges marked as internal trust, or delegation cycles - the runtime authorization layer inherits a structural weakness that cannot be recovered at request time. delegcheck reads the JSON/JSONL delegation config the harness will consume and flags ten shape defects with deterministic rules.
